_note: FROZEN EVALUATION SET for src/lib/favour-safety.ts, written 2026-10-05 BEFORE the reworked check existed. The counts the check scores on `unsafe` and `safe` are its known reach. Do not edit a case to make the check pass, and do not tune the check to these cases: add new cases instead. `walker` holds the six asks a cold walker wrote that the first version missed; those were used as development cases, so the check is expected to catch all of them and they say nothing about its reach.

_note_set2: SECOND SET, written 2026-10-05 AFTER the reworked check was frozen in commit (see git log: 'Personal data check, version 2'), by the same author, on purpose in wording that avoids the obvious nouns and possessives. The first set (unsafe, safe) was written before the check but in the same sitting by the same person, and the check scored 20 of 20 on both halves, which says more about shared authorship than about reach. This second set is the honest number. The check was not changed after it was measured.
